sloka: क्रुद्धेन विप्रमुक्तो ऽयं निर्विशेषं प्रियाप्रिये ।प्रजाः संहरते रौद्रो लोकत्रयभयावहः ।। ७.२२.४२ ॥
transliteration: kruddhena vipramukto 'yaṁ nirviśeṣaṁ priyāpriye ।prajāḥ saṁharate raudro lokatrayabhayāvahaḥ ।। 7.22.42 ॥

translations.english: Whoever, be it a god or even a human, would make my word false, by him the three worlds would indeed be made false, there is no doubt about this.
